messages:
Nina K.: Kicking off a quick thread for the upcoming docs publish — target pieces: concise changelog bullets, migration snippet for embeddings-stream -> poll, and an examples parity check. PRs: #5489 (changelog draft), #5496 (snippet updates), #5502 (examples parity). Need a sweep for link health and tiny copy edits.
Diego R.: I can check examples parity across py/js/go. Quick ask: keep the code diffs minimal, show old->new for the response/embeddings call.
Samir Patel: I'll copy-edit the bullets. For "what changed" we want 1 line per change and one-line known issues. Avoid deep explanation.
Nina K.: Agreed. Diego, can you add a 3-line code block showing conversion: old streaming -> new poll flow? Keep it JS + python.
Diego R.: Yep. JS snippet: ``const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: batch}); // poll job.status`` Python snippet: ```job = client.embeddings.create(input=batch); while job.status != 'done': sleep(1); job = client.jobs.get(job.id)``` (I'll keep it compressed).
docs-bot: Reminder: merge window for docs_changelog closes at 08:00 PT. Any changelog PRs must be merged by 06:45 PT to make the publish.
Nina K.: Thanks. Samir, I added a tentative known-issue: "Batch embeddings may incur different rate limits vs streaming; consider smaller batches/backoff." Thoughts?
Samir Patel: Good. One tweak: "Batch embeddings may observe different rate limits vs streaming; adjust batch size or backoff." Shorter.
Diego R.: FYI I also fixed a Python sample that referenced `client.generate()` -> `client.responses.create()` and left a one-line migration comment. Pushed to #5496.
link-bot: Link-check report: found 2 stale anchors under /guides/migration and one absolute http link to console-beta. Raised #5502 for fixups.
Nina K.: Can one of you merge #5496 and #5502 if CI green? I'll review #5489 after those land.
Samir Patel: I'll review #5489 now. Small language nit: change "deprecated" to "deprecated (see migration guide)" for the embedding streaming line.
Diego R.: CI green on #5496. Merging.
docs-bot: #5496 merged by Diego R.
link-bot: #5502 CI green; redirects + anchors updated.
Nina K.: Great. I pushed a micro-edit to #5489 for that phrasing. Samir, can you give final sign-off?
Samir Patel: Reviewed and approved. Merged #5489.
docs-bot: Changelog queued for publish. Post-merge link-check passed. If regressions after publish, post "docs-rollback" in this channel and tag @Nina K.
Nina K.: Thanks team — queued for release. Short retro: next time let's add a 1-line test plan for snippet parity to the PR template. :memo:
